# ChemCalc

> Free marine repair mixing calculators, curated repair kits and materials, and marine repair services, for marine professionals and DIY enthusiasts.

ChemCalc has five free calculators that need no account, with amounts checked against the manufacturers' own data; a curated catalog of repair kits and materials; and marine repair, training and fabrication services. A Pro tier adds the full Repair Estimator (labor, materials and markup) for building job quotes; it requires login and is not linked below.

## Calculators

- [Awlgrip Coatings Calculator](https://chemcalc.co/awlgrip.html): Mix amounts (base, converter, reducer) for Awlgrip Topcoat, Awlcraft 2000/3000, 545 Epoxy Primer, Awlcraft SE and Awlgrip HDT Clear, with estimated coverage, in imperial or metric units. Spray and roll/brush application (Awlcraft 2000/3000, Awlcraft SE and HDT Clear are spray-only); Pro-Cure X-98/X-138 accelerator dosing for Awlcraft 2000/3000.
- [MEKP Calculator](https://chemcalc.co/mekpcalc.html): MEKP catalyst amount, in cc and drops, for polyester resin and gelcoat, based on batch volume and ambient temperature, with a Duratec override and a custom percentage option.
- [Fiberglass Cloth Saturation Calculator](https://chemcalc.co/clothcalc.html): Resin amounts for fiberglass, carbon fiber or Kevlar laminates, based on area, layers, material type, resin system (polyester, vinylester or epoxy) and temperature.
- [Epifanes Polyurethane Paint & Varnish Calculator](https://chemcalc.co/epifanespoly.html): Mix amounts, with thinning guidance, for all six Epifanes Poly-urethane products (Clear Gloss, Clear Satin and Colour, standard and PU Speedcoat). Every product mixes 2:1, specified by weight and given as the volume equivalent.
- [Alexseal Yacht Coatings Calculator](https://chemcalc.co/alexseal.html): Mix amounts (base, converter, reducer and accelerator) for Alexseal Premium Topcoat 501, Finish Primer 442 and Protective Primer 161, for spray or brush/roll application, with estimated coverage.
- [How We Compare](https://chemcalc.co/compare.html): How each ChemCalc calculator compares with the other tools found online, and where we didn't find another tool.

## Kits, Materials & Safety

- [Marine Repair Kits & Boat Building Supplies](https://chemcalc.co/kits.html): Curated marine repair kits, fiberglass supplies, Awlgrip paint, epoxy and tools, each linked to Amazon or the supplier through affiliate links; custom kits can be requested.
- [Awlgrip Topcoats Safety Guidelines](https://chemcalc.co/awlgrip-safety.html): Handling, storage, first aid, exposure controls, fire fighting, accidental release and disposal for Awlgrip topcoats.
- [MEKP Safety Guidelines](https://chemcalc.co/mekp-safety.html): Handling, storage, first aid, exposure controls, fire fighting and disposal for MEKP.

## Services

- [Marine Repair Services & Training](https://chemcalc.co/services.html): Structural and cosmetic marine repair, training and tele-guiding, kit subscriptions, custom fabrication and custom vinyl lettering.
